## What's new

Coming from 1.0.0: update once with ChaOS Installer (Update keeps your games, saves and settings). 1.1.0 is built on TortOS 2.2.0, which a 1.0.0 Brick can't install by itself. From 1.1.0 on, the Brick updates itself again, even across TortOS releases.

- Night Mode (MENU > Night Mode): eight quieter volume steps below the lowest.
- The clock and battery in every menu's heading, set under MENU > Date & Time (12h/24h Clock, Battery).
- Appearance (MENU > Appearance): theme, direction, speed, list view and menu color on one page.
- Recently Played: the last twelve games you played, at the front of the shelf.
- ChaOS Wire: ChaOS Transfer over the USB cable, which can also update ChaOS from your computer.
- Updates every half hour from the shelf and menus, never during a game, and a whole-system update for releases on a newer TortOS.
- The battery runs to its end: a game is saved and the Brick turns off by voltage, about half an hour later than before; no game resumes on an empty battery.
- Games' clocks follow your time zone.
- Built on TortOS 2.2.0 and ChaOS-diatom 0.9.5.

---

ChaOS 1.1.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v1.1.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.2.0](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.2.0) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v1.1.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
